DeckPilot Atelier 1.0.8 starts its independent release channel. Atelier releases use `atelier-v1.0.x` tags and contain only Atelier, its installer, metadata and the bundled firmware.

Atelier checks only stable `atelier-vX.Y.Z` releases. Its app and firmware updates remain separate from the DeckPilot 1.9.x channel and always ask before installing or flashing.
